email.subject1: a signal play for Activated Insights
email.body1:
Matt, saw Activated Insights acquired WeCare Connect and CareAcademy, and just landed Senior Helpers across 410+ locations.

Two acquisitions plus a marquee win usually means more cross-sell accounts in play than the BD team can cover, and that is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Activated Insights off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matt, quick follow-up for Activated Insights.

After folding in two platforms, the cross-sell expectation on BD climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need booked to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings you need to hit target across the combined base, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matt, last bit of proof for Activated Insights.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to peers integrating acquisitions. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matt, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling cross-sell pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating two acquisitions while onboarding a 410-location win is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Activated Insights either way.
